items.title: Constraints files with spaces
items.reason: This reports the same quoted-path splitting on the neighboring `--constraint` option. Maintainer comments confirm that CLI and environment-variable values share space-delimited parsing.

items.title: Fix quoted requirement-file paths
items.reason: This pre-existing draft explicitly covers constraint, override, and exclude paths by preserving CLI paths while splitting only environment-provided lists.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged pull requests using literal terms including `--overrides`, `File not found`, `override.txt`, Windows, and quoted paths with spaces; conceptual terms covering whitespace splitting, requirement and constraint paths, CLI versus environment parsing; and fix-oriented history. astral-sh/uv#15806 and astral-sh/uv#15815 were adjacent `--env-file` cases, while astral-sh/uv#17227 concerned the unrelated `-` stdin regression.

type_reason: astral-sh/uv#12639 already tracks the same underlying quoted requirements-file path splitting in the shared space-delimited parsing used by `--constraint` and `--overrides`. The pre-existing astral-sh/uv-dev#158 proposes a fix covering both flags.
summary: This is a Windows-specific reproduction of the open cross-platform problem in astral-sh/uv#12639, with a draft fix already in astral-sh/uv-dev#158.
draft_response: Thanks for the clear reproduction. This is the same underlying file-path parsing problem tracked in astral-sh/uv#12639: `--constraint` and `--overrides` currently use the same space-delimited parsing as their environment-variable forms, so quoting a CLI path does not prevent it from being split. A draft fix covering constraint, override, and exclude paths is in astral-sh/uv-dev#158. Let’s centralize the discussion in astral-sh/uv#12639.
